FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Do we need separate pages for each town?

Yes, if you want to rank across a region. Listing towns in a footer does not work; genuine local pages do.

Can customers send photos with a quote request?

Yes. Photo upload in the quote form saves a great deal of wasted travel on inaccurate estimates.

Will the site work well on a phone?

It is designed mobile-first. Most emergency electrical searches happen on a phone, often in a hurry.

How long does it take?

Typically four to six weeks including service area pages and local SEO setup.
